name: Muktamar Photo API
description: Authenticated API for Muktamar photo validation.
author: Evonic

variables.name: API_KEYS
variables.label: API keys (comma-separated)
variables.description: API keys accepted by the external photo-validation endpoint. Prefer an environment variable in production.

variables.name: MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
variables.label: Maximum upload size (bytes)
variables.description: Hard request limit; validator also enforces its own 8 MiB limit.
